caption: The drawing depicts two metal objects on a plain, light beige background. The object on the left is a hinge with a decorative, symmetrical shape featuring a central cutout and curved ends, resembling a stylized floral or trident form. It is dark brown in color with visible rust, and has four visible circular rivet holes, one at the top, one in the center, and two near the bottom at the hinge section, which is rectangular. The object on the right is an elongated metal latch mechanism, also dark brown with rust coloration. The upper part is rectangular with a cutout slot and a small semicircular loop at the top. A hooked latch protrudes from the right side, connected to a circular rivet. The bottom end of the latch is a decorative element with a symmetrical cutout similar to that of the hinge on the left, and it also has four small visible rivet holes along its length. The drawing is annotated at the lower right side with the text "NEL. M. N. Y. A. JOHN METRUCCI" in small red capital letters.
title: Conestoga Hasp and Hinge
